tests.title: main counts an existing file
tests.procedure: write bytes b'hello world\nfoo\n' to a temp file F; call main(['count', F]) capturing stdout and stderr
tests.expected: returns 0; stdout is exactly '2 3 16\n'; stderr is empty

tests.title: main on empty file
tests.procedure: create an empty temp file F; call main(['count', F])

tests.title: main on file without trailing newline
tests.procedure: write bytes b'a b\nc' to temp file F; call main(['count', F])

tests.title: main missing path with Korean name
tests.procedure: P = a nonexistent path '<tmpdir>/없는파일.txt'; call main(['count', P]) capturing stdout and stderr
tests.expected: returns 2; stdout is empty; stderr is exactly 'error: file not found: ' + P + '\n'

tests.title: main missing file returns 2
tests.procedure: call main(['count', '<tmpdir>/missing.txt']) capturing stdout and stderr
tests.expected: returns 2; stdout is empty; stderr is exactly 'error: file not found: <tmpdir>/missing.txt\n'

tests.title: main invalid command line exits 2
tests.procedure: call main(['bogus']) and main(['count']) (no path), each inside pytest.raises(SystemExit)
tests.expected: both calls raise SystemExit with code 2; nothing is written to stdout

tests.title: CLI counts two-line file
tests.procedure: write bytes b'hello world\nfoo\n' to F; run `python -m textcli count F` (PYTHONPATH=src)

tests.title: CLI counts file without trailing newline
tests.procedure: write bytes b'a b\nc' to F; run `python -m textcli count F`

tests.title: CLI counts Korean characters not bytes
tests.procedure: write UTF-8 bytes of '안녕 세상\n' to F; run `python -m textcli count F`

tests.title: CLI counts newline-only file
tests.procedure: write bytes b'\n' to F; run `python -m textcli count F`

tests.title: CLI empty file
tests.procedure: create a zero-byte file F; run `python -m textcli count F`

tests.title: CLI missing file
tests.procedure: run `python -m textcli count <tmpdir>/does-not-exist.txt` for a path that does not exist
tests.expected: stdout empty, stderr 'error: file not found: <tmpdir>/does-not-exist.txt', exit code 2
